top_signal.title: Looking for a reliable courier for a very large box from London to Northern Ireland, UK
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone,   I need to send one large box from London to Northern Ireland and I'm struggling to find a standard courier that will accept the dimensions.   The box is:      130 cm long     96 cm wide     95 cm deep     12 kg     1 box      I'm mainly looking for a  reliable service that can collect from London and deliver to Northern Ireland . I'm not too concerned about getting the absolute cheapest price — reliability and getting it there safely are more important.   Has anyone sent something this large from London to NI before? If so, which courier/freight company did you use?   I'd really appreciate any recommendations or suggestions for companies that handle oversized parcels.   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/PossiblePoet9495       [link]       [comments]
